source.label: Notifications issued under section 52(1) of the Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 (GST Council tax repository)

note: Section 52(1) sets only a ceiling; the collected rate is fixed by notification, and each notification fixes ONE leg. Notification 52/2018-Central Tax fixes the CGST leg at "half per cent. of the net value of intra-State taxable supplies"; notification 15/2024-Central Tax substitutes "0.25 per cent." for "half per cent." with effect from its publication on 10 July 2024. The settlement file withholds TCS as TCS-CGST + TCS-SGST on an intra-State supply, or TCS-IGST on an inter-State one, and all three map to LineKind.TCS, so what a detector recomputes is the AGGREGATE: twice the CGST leg. That is what percent_bp encodes. This resolves RS3 open item 5: the secondary sources reporting "1% to 0.5%" and "0.25%" are both right, the first quoting the aggregate and the second the CGST leg.

citation.label: Notification No. 52/2018-Central Tax, 20 September 2018: electronic commerce operators collect "half per cent." of the net value of intra-State taxable supplies (CGST leg). Aggregate encoded here is the CGST leg doubled; the mirroring SGST and IGST notifications were not read in this session.

Notification No. 15/2024-Central Tax, 10 July 2024: for the words "half per cent.", the figure and word "0.25 per cent." shall be substituted; in force from the date of publication. Aggregate encoded here is the CGST leg doubled; the mirroring SGST and IGST notifications were not read in this session.
